sentences.text: Bavaricarbo brevirostris is an extinct genus of cormorant, a type of waterbird.
This species was discovered in Germany at the Hammerschmiede clay pit and described by Mayr, Lechner, and Böhme in the Swiss Journal of Palaeontology.
The presence of this bird and other fish-eaters suggests the local river system was highly productive with ample prey.
Taxonomically, it belongs to the stem group of the cormorant family Phalacrocoracidae.
Fossils from this site date to the early Late Miocene, specifically the earliest Tortonian stage.
